shortDescription: Manages access policies on Cisco FMC devices over REST API

options.name: depth
options.description: The depth level for nested object retrieval, controlling how many levels of nesting to process. Default is 1, meaning only direct objects are retrieved.

options.name: domain_uuid
options.description: Domain UUID of the FMC. This is required for all operations.

options.name: expanded
options.description: When set to True, returns detailed information for all retrieved objects.

options.name: object_type
options.description: Type of objects to retrieve when using getNestedObjects operation.

options.name: operation
options.description: The name of the operation to execute. Available operations include 'getAllAccessPolicies', 'getAccessPolicy', 'getAllAccessRules', 'getAccessRule'

options.name: output_dir
options.description: Directory where JSON output files will be saved when using the module in a playbook. The module will automatically create this directory if it doesn't exist.

options.name: policy_id
options.description: ID of the access policy to retrieve when using getAccessPolicy or getAllAccessRules operations.

options.name: register_as
options.description: Specifies Ansible fact name that is used to register received response from the FMC device.

options.name: rule_id
options.description: ID of the access rule to retrieve when using getAccessRule operation.
